from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class DocumentRecord(BaseModel):
    """A single legal document record with its metadata and legal cause."""
    title: str = Field(description="The document title or identifier (e.g., '《判决文书 X》')")
    document_type: str = Field(description="The specific nature of the document (e.g., '判决书', '裁定书', '通知书')")
    case_cause: str = Field(description="The specific legal case cause stated in the document (案由)")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    documents: list[DocumentRecord]
